method.tone: OLS sine/cosine/DC at exact frequency; 120 s, last 60 s; unit input 1 mV
method.transient: zero-state independent recurrence; summaries only, no signal dumps
method.observation: Read primitive state after SignalPipeline.step; full native replay, no annotations during processing
method.difference: same unit, same input clock; transformed content is not automatically noise
method.costs: not measured; B04 owns cost/hardware/browser validation
